$ agentflow config set --dry-run autonomy.local=auto approval_window=10m
--- stdout

personal:approval_window: (unset) → "10m"
info loosens personal:autonomy.local: Allows local actions without confirmation.
info loosens personal:approval_window: Lengthens the approval window from 5m to 10m.
